# ===== A. STATEMENTS =====

# A1. The old man gave Mary a red book yesterday.
E1: old man-1 give red book-1 [to: Mary] [time: yesterday] [PAST]

# A2. Well, the report that John said yesterday he would probably send to Mary before Friday wasn't actually finished.
E1: John say E2 [time: yesterday] [PAST]
E2*: John send report-1 [to: Mary] [before: Friday] [mode: probably] [FUTURE]
E3: _ not finish report-1 [PAST]

# A3. John did not promise to leave.
E1: John not promise E2 [PAST]
E2*: John leave

# A4. John promised not to leave.
E1: John promise E2 [PAST]
E2*: John not leave

# A5. John told Peter he was late.   (ambiguous pronoun: both candidates are kept)
E1: John tell E2 [to: Peter] [PAST]
E2*: John|Peter be late [PAST]

# A6. Mary knows that the server crashed.   (factive verb: the content is also a fact)
E1: Mary know E2
E2: server-1 crash [PAST]

# A7. If it rains tomorrow, we will stay home.
E1*: _ rain [time: tomorrow]
E2: we stay [place: home] [if: E1] [FUTURE]

# A8. Every student who failed the exam must repeat the course.
E1*: student-1 fail exam-1 [PAST]
E2: every student-1{that: E1} repeat course-1 [mode: must]

# A9. The report on sales was written by Ana.   (passive with agent becomes active)
E1: Ana write report-1{on: sale-1+} [PAST]

# A10a. Tom saw the man with the telescope.   (reading 1: the man has the telescope)
E1: Tom see man-1{with: telescope-1} [PAST]

# A10b. Tom saw the man with the telescope.   (reading 2: Tom used the telescope)
E1: Tom see man-1 [with: telescope-1] [PAST]

# A11. Dogs don't like cats.
E1: dog-0 not like cat-0 [HABIT]

# A12. Nobody answered, although the phone rang three times.
E1: nobody-1 answer [although: E2] [PAST]
E2: phone-1 ring [freq: 3_time] [PAST]

# A13. John is taller than his brother.
E1: John be taller [than: brother-1{of: John}]

# A14. Either the disk is full or the network is down.
E1*: disk-1 be full
E2*: network-1 be down
E3: either E1 or E2

# A15. The meeting, which started late, lasted two hours.
E1: meeting-1 start [time: late] [PAST]
E2: meeting-1 last [duration: 2_hour] [PAST]

# A16. Only Ana has not signed the contract yet.
E1: only Ana not sign contract-1 [time: yet] [PERF]

# A17. You must not open the valve.   (obligation NOT to open)
E1: you not open valve-1 [mode: must]

# A18. You need not open the valve.   (NO obligation to open)
E1: you open valve-1 [mode: not need]

# A19. Ana bought a laptop. It was expensive, but she likes it.
E1: Ana buy laptop-1 [PAST]
E2: laptop-1 be expensive [PAST]
E3: Ana like laptop-1 [but: E2]

# A20. John sent one report to Mary and another to Peter.
E1: John send report-1 [to: Mary] [PAST]
E2: John send report-2 [to: Peter] [PAST]

# A21. Smoking is not allowed here.
E1*: _ smoke
E2: _ not allow E1 [place: here]

# A22. Not every user reads the manual.
E1: not_every user-1 read manual-1 [HABIT]

# A23. The sign says "No entry".
E1: sign-1 say "No entry"

# A24. John and Mary are doctors, and John is a very good one.
E1: John and Mary be doctor
E2: John be very good doctor

# ===== B. QUESTIONS =====

# B1. Did John send the report?
E1?: John send report-1 [PAST]

# B2. Who sent the report to Mary?
E1?: ?who send report-1 [to: Mary] [PAST]

# B3. Why didn't you call me yesterday?
E1?: you not call I [cause: ?why] [time: yesterday] [PAST]

# B4. Which students passed the exam?
E1?: ?which student-1+ pass exam-1 [PAST]

# B5. How many servers are running?
E1?: ?how_many server-1+ run [PROG]

# B6. Do you know when the train leaves?
E1?: you know E2
E2*?: train-1 leave [time: ?when]

# B7. John asked whether Mary had left.
E1: John ask E2 [PAST]
E2*?: Mary leave [PAST] [PERF]

# B8. Whose car is parked outside?
E1?: _ park car-1{of: ?who} [place: outside]

# B9. How much does the license cost?
E1?: license-1 cost ?how_much

# ===== C. ORDERS, REQUESTS, QUERIES =====

# C1. Close the door!
E1!: you close door-1 [EMPH]

# C2. Please send me the file before noon.
E1!: you send file-1 [to: I] [before: noon] [POLITE]

# C3. Don't touch that!
E1!: you not touch that [EMPH]

# C4. Could you tell Ana to restart the server?
E1!: you tell E2 [to: Ana] [POLITE]
E2*: Ana restart server-1

# C5. Let's meet at 10:30 on 2026-10-12.
E1!: we meet [at: 10:30] [on: 2026-10-12]

# C6. Show me all orders from 2024 that cost more than 500 euros.
E1!: you show all order-1+{from: 2024}{that: E2} [to: I]
E2*: order-1 cost >500_euro

# C7. List the names of customers who have not paid.
E1!: you list name-1+{of: customer-1+{that: E2}}
E2*: customer-1 not pay [PERF]

# C8. What is the average salary per department?
E1?: average salary-1{per: department-1} be ?what

# C9. Never restart the database without a backup.
E1!: you restart database-1 [without: backup-1] [freq: never]

# ===== D. EXCLAMATIONS AND EMOTION =====

# D1. Wow, what a beautiful day!
E1^: wow
E2: day-1 be beautiful [EMPH]

# D2. I'm so happy you came!
E1: I be so happy [cause: E2] [EMPH]
E2: you come [PAST]

# D3. Ouch! That hurts!
E1^: ouch [EMPH]
E2: that hurt [EMPH]

# D4. Thanks a lot for your help!
E1^: thanks [degree: a_lot] [for: help-1{of: you}] [EMPH]

# D5. If only I had more time!
E1: I have more time-1 [mode: wish] [EMPH]

# D6. Damn, I hate this stupid printer!
E1^: damn
E2: I hate stupid printer-1 [EMPH]

# D7. Good morning, Mary!
E1^: good morning [to: Mary] [EMPH]

# D8. Sorry I'm late.
E1^: sorry [cause: E2]
E2: I be late

# D9. "Will you come?"  "No!"
E1?: you come [FUTURE]
E2^: "no" [EMPH]

# ===== E. MATHEMATICS =====

# E1. x squared plus two x plus one equals zero.
E1: $x^2 + 2*x + 1 = 0$

# E2. The area of a circle is pi times the radius squared.
E1: area-1{of: circle-0} be $pi * radius^2$

# E3. If x is greater than 3, then y equals 2x.
E1*: $x > 3$
E2: $y = 2*x$ [if: E1]

# E4. Let n be the number of users.
E1: $n$ be number-1{of: user-1+} [mode: let]

# E5. The error is at most 5%.
E1: error-1 be <=5%

# E6. Solve 3x - 7 = 11 for x.
E1!: you solve $3*x - 7 = 11$ [for: $x$]

# E7. The sum of the first n integers is n(n+1)/2.
E1: $sum(i, 1, n, i) = n*(n+1)/2$

# E8. Is the square root of 2 smaller than 1.5?
E1?: $sqrt(2) < 1.5$

# E9. The train travels about 300 km at 120 km/h.
E1: train-1 travel ~300_km [at: 120_km/h]

# ===== F. CLEANING NOISY TEXT =====

# F1. Um, so basically, I think, you know, the server is, like, down again.
E1: I think E2
E2*: server-1 be down [freq: again]

# F2. Honestly, I... I mean, we really, really need to fix this bug today!!!
E1: we need E2 [degree: really] [EMPH]
E2*: we fix bug-1 [time: today]

# F3. So, uh, could you maybe, like, check the logs, please?
E1!: you check log-1+ [mode: maybe] [POLITE]
